name: 承認の担当・期限・依存関係
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Create ONE Japanese Lighthouse approval properties block LH09-0036,666x144 logical pixels. Original images1–2 control original icon/photo appearances, proportions, thin strokes, alignment, spacing and visible empty states. Image3 supplies Japanese wording only; do NOT copy mint initials avatar or square substitute calendar.
Pure WHITE #FFFFFF canvas and ordinary surfaces, no cards/panels/borders/shadows. Source compact left-aligned two-column properties with labels at x22 and values at x154 logical pixels. Three rows about38px apart, then bottom text link.
Row1: label「担当者」Regular12/16. Value ORIGINAL small dark photo avatar appearance,24px circle, then Japanese name「山田 花子」Regular14/24, then original tiny X remove action. To its right, original unboxed status dropdown「最近割り当て」Regular12/16 with small thin DOWN chevron. Preserve photo appearance from original, no fabricated mint badge/initial avatar. Keep original spacing rather than forcing this dropdown to far right.
Row2: label「期日」. Value ORIGINAL small calendar INSIDE a dashed circular enclosure, then「期日なし」in neutral Regular14/24. Retain the source detailed calendar bindings, fine rectangular body and dashed-circle stroke; no empty square substitute.
Row3: label「依存関係」. Value text action「依存関係を追加」in neutral Regular14/24, no added icon.
Bottom at x22: brand-green #1F6444 text link「継承した項目を表示」Regular12/16. No underline.
All ordinary support icons slate #526173, source-like small optical sizes and light consistent stroke. Typography Meiryo, zero tracking, ALL regular weight, no bold. Match compact original readable hierarchy and baselines. No headings, extra fields, buttons, colored panels, app shell, watermark, perspective, comparison grid or annotations. Tight framing.
reviewNotes: 担当者・山田花子・最近割り当て・期日なし・依存関係・継承リンクを目視。原本の写真アバターの外観、削除X、下向き矢印、破線円付きカレンダーを復元し、モックのミント面と四角代替を避けた。白面・通常ウェイト。写真バイト・フォント・ベクター同一性、権限とアプリ動作は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Chromeで観察した公開画像URLまたは文書化された画像保存
